_comment: Geographic placement read off the 1899 Key (Index Map) and cross-checked against the neighbour numbers printed in each sheet's margins. Galveston Island runs bay (northwest) on the left to Gulf of Mexico (southeast) on the right; street numbers increase top to bottom. Column 0 is the wharf/pier strip along Galveston Bay; columns 1-3 run inland toward Broadway. Sheet 11's margins give west 8/7, north 43, east 12, south 13; sheet 12's give west 11, north 44, east 41, south 14 -- both agree with the Key. The wharf sheets sit about half a row above the inland grid, so sheet 5 has no inland partners in this selection and its row is otherwise empty. Values are [row, col].
